introduce:
Start with your back against the wall. Slide your body downward, keeping your knees slightly bent to keep your body stable.

Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides and press them on the wall.

Exhale and drive your arms up along the wall. Inhale and pull your arms down. Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL SLIDE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back against the wall.
Keep your core engaged.
Exhale on the way up and inhale on the way down.
This exercise can fire up your back and shoulder muscles.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length. Press your right hand firmly into the wall for support.

Stretch your upper body sideways towards the wall, lifting your left arm overhead. Hold this position for 15 seconds.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:

name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.

Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:
Stand with your back against the wall and feet hip-width apart. Extend your arms forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other.

Extend your arms as far out as possible, then move them back to the front.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL DYNAMIC CHEST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Move your arms as far back as possible.
You can gradually increase the speed.
Inhale as you open your arms, and exhale as you bring them back together.
This exercise stretches your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your back against the wall, feet hip-width apart, and arms by your sides.

Drop your head down and slowly roll your spine down from the wall, segment by segment. Reach your hands towards the floor.

Roll back up to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING ROLL DOWN

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
Engage your core muscles.
Feel your back muscles lengthening as you descend.
Exhale as you roll down from the wall, and inhale as you roll back.
It stretches the back muscles.
It promotes spinal mobility.

introduce:
Come into a low lunge with your right foot below your right knee and your left leg extended back, touching the wall. Bring your hands to the floor beneath your shoulders.

Hold this position, and then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight.

Return and repeat it.
name: WALL KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your spine and pelvis.
Allow your hips to move forward and backward in a controlled manner.
Keep your supporting arms stable or stretch them gently when needed.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise strengthens the quadriceps and hip flexors.

introduce:

Hold this position, and then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Return and repeat it.
name: WALL KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length, pressing your right hand firmly into it for support.

Engage your hips to fully extend the left leg, while reaching your left arm overhead.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING ARM & LEG LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Focus on engaging your hips.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
Exhale as you extend your leg and arm, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
It stretches hips and spine.
It strengthens the gluteus medius.

introduce:
Stand facing a wall about a few inches away from it. Place your hands on the wall at chest height and slightly wider than shoulder width.

Bend your left knee to 90 degrees and engage your hips to rotate the leg rightward. Then, extend your left leg to the left side as far as possible while keeping it straight.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING HIP ABDUCTION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Keep your back straight.
Focus on engaging your hips.
Ensure your supporting leg remains firmly planted on the ground.
Exhale as you rotate and extend your left leg to the side.
Inhale as you bring your leg back to the starting position with control.
This workout strengthens the glutes.

introduce:

Bend your right knee to 90 degrees and engage your hips to rotate the leg leftward. Then, extend your right leg to the right side as far as possible while keeping it straight.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING HIP ABDUCTION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.

Focus on engaging your hips.

introduce:
Stand facing the wall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands touching the wall, about a forearm's length from it.

Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Go up. Then, twist your body to the left side, and bring your back knee down to the floor.

Return to the starting position, switch sides, and then repeat.
name: WALL ROTATING LUNGE TO SUMO SQUAT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Avoid leaning too heavily on the wall.
Inhale as you lower into the lunge, and exhale as you rotate into the sumo squat.
It stretches the chest.
It strengthens the quadriceps.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall. Bend your right knee to place your right arm toward the ground, then straighten your right leg.

Gaze downward and extend your left arm against the wall. Lift your left leg off the ground, extending it as wide as possible.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL HALF MOON LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your right-hand fingertips are under your right shoulder.
Keep your gaze down for balance.
Keep your right leg as straight as possible.
Exhale as you lift the left leg, and inhale as you lower it down.
It strengthens the gluteus maximus.
It builds strength in your thighs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall a few inches away. Bend your left knee to place your left arm toward the ground, then straighten your left leg.

Gaze downward and extend your right arm against the wall. Lift your right leg off the ground, extending it as wide as possible.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce:
Stand with your back against the wall, feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Place your arms in front.

Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Return to the starting position, lift your heels off the ground, then drop.

Repeat it.
name: WALL SUMO SQUATS AND CALF RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on your heels to support your body.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Avoid leaning your body forward.
Inhale as you squat down, and exhale as you go up.
This exercise strengthens the thigh adductors, quadriceps, and triceps surae.
